name: needs-analysis
title_zh: 开课前把组织、任务、学员三层需求一次摸清
tagline_zh: 别急着写大纲。先做证据式需求分析，产出共享项目清单，让后续目标撰写和质量评审直接读取，不返工。
tagline_en: Don't jump to outlines. Run evidence-based org, task & learner analysis first—output a shared manifest downstream.
desc_en: Evidence-based three-level needs assessment for instructional design. Guides you through organizational, task, and learner analysis before building a course. Creates a shared project manifest that downstream skills (/learning-objectives, /course-quality-review) read and extend. (idstack)
why_zh: 不是问卷模板堆砌，而是按三层证据链逐级收敛，每步结论都落进结构化清单，让下游技能自动继承上下文。
why_en: Not a survey dump—it converges via a three-level evidence chain, persisting findings into a structured manifest downstream.
limit_zh: 只覆盖需求分析阶段，不产出学习目标或课程内容；需配合 /learning-objectives 等下游技能使用。
limit_en: Covers needs analysis only—no objectives or content. Requires downstream skills like /learning-objectives to be useful alone it's just a checklist.
